patthana16.51:1.1: sahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na anidassana appaṭigho na hetu na sahetuko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, hetuyā cha.
patthana16.51:2.1: anidassana appaṭighaṃ na hetuṃ ahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na sanidassana sappaṭigho na hetu na ahetuko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, hetuyā tīṇi. anidassana sappaṭighaṃ
